items.t: Joined California and 14 other states in a lawsuit challenging President Trump's national emergency declaration and diversion of funds, which seeks to block construction of the border wall.
items.q: Connecticut Attorney General William Tong today joined California and 14 other states in a lawsuit challenging President Trump’s declaration of a national emergency and his attempt to divert funding appropriated by Congress.

items.t: Vowed to fight in any court in any state where access to reproductive healthcare is under threat.

items.t: Joined a coalition of 18 states, 16 local governments, and the U.S. Conference of Mayors in filing a merits brief in the U.S. Supreme Court in the case challenging the Trump Administration's attempt to add a citizenship question to the 2020 Census.

record.t: Filed a lawsuit against Kalshi arguing its sports event contracts must comply with Connecticut sports betting licensing laws.
